CHANGELOG updated in ECOWAR: Fixed real 'failed to join match' bug: the manually-started ECOWAR 1v1 matchmaker was missing REDGARDEN_TICKET_SECRET, so it matched real players but the spawned arena server rejected every join (fail-closed). Restarted with the env var set (matching PLAY.bat's own client-side value); verified a real connection now succeeds. Honest limitation: systemd deploy of the already-correctly-configured units isn't possible from this sandbox (no user D-Bus session) -- currently running as a manual background process that won't survive a reboot, real systemd deploy still needed as follow-up. Apple #16426. session: sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
